variables.name: MM_FEVER
variables.label: BC: mom had fever Note: This variable is from the "Characteristics of Labor and Delivery (45)" section of the U.S. standard birth certificate. This variable is coded as "yes" if chorioamnionitis is coded “Y”, it is coded as “no” if chorioamnionitis is  “N” , else it is coded “unknown”.

variables.name: MM_HBP
variables.label: BC: hypertension? Note: This variable is from the "Risk factors in this pregnancy (41)" section of the U.S. standard birth certificate. This variable is coded as "yes" if either prepregnancy hypertension or gestational hypertension is coded “Y”, it is coded as “no” if both are “N”, else it is coded “unknown”.

variables.name: MM_NOMD
variables.label: BC: No medical risk factors? Note: This variable is coded as "yes" if prepregnancy diabetes, gestational diabetes, prepregnancy hypertension, gestational hypertension, previous preterm births, poor pregnancy outcome, and vaginal bleeding are all coded “N”, it is coded as “no” if any are “Y”, else it is coded as “unknown”. variables.name: MOMCIG
variables.label: No. of cigarettes smoked daily during pregnancy Note: This variable is calculated by finding the average of the No. of Cigs in 1st Trimester, No. of Cigs in 2nd Trimester, and No. of Cigs in 3rd Trimester.  If any of these 3 values is unknown then variable is coded “unknown”.

variables.name: MOMSMOKE
variables.label: Did mom smoke? Note: This variable is coded “yes” if Mom smoked in any of the three trimesters.
